text: Here is the plan for next month. Can you look at the three ad ideas and tell me which one you like?

Thanks so much for this. I like the second idea best because it shows the crew on a real roof. Can we also use the photo from the Elm Street job? The first idea is fine too if you need a backup. Really happy with how this is going so far.
The October numbers are in. Calls are up and the new page is doing well. Want to go over it on Thursday?
Great news and thanks for the update. Thursday works for me and my wife will join too because she handles the books now. Please send the numbers before the call so we can read them first.
The new ads are ready for you to approve. Can you look today?
Noted. Why did the calls drop last week?
Calls dropped because of the rain that week. They are back up now. Here is the chart.
Please advise. Can you explain what we are paying for?
Here is everything we did this month. Can we find a new time for the call you missed?
Received. Why did the calls drop last week?
Bookings are up again this month. Here is the report for you and the team.
This is great and the team loved it. Can we add the new cleaning offer to the ads next month?
The cleaning offer is live now. I will send the first numbers on Friday.
Perfect and thank you. We already had two people ask about it at the front desk this week.
The cleaning offer brought in 14 bookings. Want to keep it running in December?
Yes please keep it going. We are also thinking about a second clinic so let us talk about that soon too.
Happy to talk about the second clinic. Does Thursday work?
Thursday works. Talk then and thanks again.
